trajectory.thought: The leader (dba, a robust DTW barycenter) is a seed baseline and the verdict is 'indistinguishable' from the runner-up (mean, margin 0.00119). With unstable ranking (Kendall tau 0.01), correlated errors (9 groups, only 5 independent), and only 3 validation windows making weight estimation high-variance, the robust dba combination is well-suited to this series. More turns are unlikely to turn this noise-level gap into a real gain.

action_args.justification: The series has a strong trend (0.98) and seasonality (0.69) with non-stationary behavior. Model ranking is highly unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.01) and errors are heavily correlated (mean 0.775, only 5 independent groups out of 19 models). In this regime, a robust combination like DTW barycenter (dba) that does not chase per-window noise is the right structural choice. The leader's margin over the runner-up (mean) is 0.00119 — statistically indistinguishable — and all 10 seeded baselines cluster within 0.05 score, confirming that no simple re-weighting or subset selection can reliably separate them on 3 windows. Accepting the robust baseline is the safest and most defensible choice.
